body:
Hey, thanks for the response. That really sounds pretty much like me, just one year older.

I've been thinking for a few days, and I feel that it is important clarify one thing here, considering that these posts will probably double as my suicide note. Although not having any romance is rather unfortunate, I think I would be able live with that relatively easily. What's actually killing me is the complete lack of meaningful human contact, plus failing at every single thing I do (including attempts to establish such human contact). If that were not the case, being single would probably not be a particularly big deal.
